name: Farinuff 2.5D Pixel Fleet
brief: Low-poly 3D spacecraft translated into compact transparent pixel-art sprites: hard faceted planes, stepped toon shading, near-black silhouettes, and hot cyan, orange, green, or magenta emissive cores against the deep-space palette of the supplied gameplay render.
application: Apply this visual treatment to every player, enemy, and boss sprite while preserving each existing runtime role, silhouette, proportions, generation family, frame anchor, and transparent sprite-strip layout.
must_preserve: the supplied gameplay render as a style anchor for medium, rendering, palette relationships, edge treatment, texture, and lighting only
the current player and enemy sprite identities as separate identity anchors
128x128 logical frame cells, centered 64x64 anchors, four-frame horizontal strips, and transparent backgrounds
role-readable silhouettes and the existing player, enemy, and boss family distinctions

lock.medium: Stylized low-poly 3D hard-surface spacecraft presented as crisp pixel-art sprite renders, with geometry readable through stepped planes rather than painterly brushwork.
lock.rendering: Nearest-neighbor pixel presentation with compact 4-5 step toon bands, selective one-pixel dithering, dark occlusion pockets, and controlled emissive bloom around engines, weapons, and reactor cores.
lock.line_and_edge: Hard faceted contours with a near-black navy outline or occlusion rim, stepped diagonal edges, pixel stair-stepping, and no anti-aliased vector linework.
lock.shape_language: Compact readable spacecraft built from pointed fuselages, swept wings, modular armor plates, inset reactor cores, and small engine blocks; each gameplay role receives a distinct silhouette before color is considered.
palette: background and occlusion: near-black #020309 through deep navy #071129
player: ice white #D7EEFF, cyan #6BD7FF and electric cyan #00C8FF over dark navy structural planes
basic and assault: scarlet #FF3B24, ember orange #FF6B24, and reactor gold #FFC14D
fast: hot orange #FF8A24 with small cyan-white targeting accents
bomber: toxic green #6CFF7A, lime #B7FF4A, and restrained warm core highlights
sniper: cyan-blue #28BFFF with red-orange reactor contrast
tank and boss structure: deep violet #35106E, electric purple #7A2BFF, and near-black recessed planes
boss form accents: assault scarlet/ember, bulwark violet/magenta, Tempest storm cyan/blue, Tempest Core amber/gold, Void Harbinger spectral acid green, all with white-hot reactor centers
powerups and high-value accents: gold #FFC04D or pink-white #FFB6F5
lock.lighting: Cool cyan key light from upper left, deep violet fill and rim from the surrounding space, hard planar occlusion, and small white-hot emissive cores that bloom only a few pixels beyond the source.
lock.texture: Sparse pixel dithering, subtle CRT scanline breakup, tiny star-like specular pixels, and stepped emissive halos; surfaces remain clean and game-readable with no smooth photographic noise or soft gradients.
lock.composition: For sprite assets, one centered isolated spacecraft per logical frame on true transparency, with generous empty margin and a visually stable 64x64 anchor; gameplay staging belongs to the 1280x720 scene and must not be baked into the sprites.
must_not_change: the existing runtime sprite families or their gameplay roles
the logical frame size, centered anchor, horizontal four-frame strip contract, or transparent background
the readable silhouette hierarchy between player, basic, fast, bomber, sniper, tank, and boss classes
the distinction between player cyan-white energy, enemy role colors, and the separate assault, bulwark, Tempest, Tempest Core, and Void Harbinger boss palettes
avoid: unrequested text or UI baked into sprite assets
backgrounds, stars, planets, beams, or HUD elements in transparent sprites
photorealistic rendering, smooth gradients, painterly brushwork, or anti-aliased vector edges
overly large player or enemy silhouettes that reduce playfield readability
unrequested topology changes, extra weapons, or copied boss/player compositions from the style anchor

reference_images.description: User-approved 1280x720 gameplay render controlling the 2.5D low-poly spacecraft finish, deep-space contrast, cyan HUD-adjacent energy, violet boss materials, magenta emissive effects, crisp pixel edges, and small player read; do not copy its exact identities, layout, or object topology.
